svg.text: Cement Plant IoT — Dual ESP32 System Wiring Schematic

g.text: DOUT → GPIO5 | Load cell: Iron ore
Active-LOW input | Loads on NO contacts
• ESP32-1 and ESP32-2 grounds are NOT common with each other — each board's GND ties only to its own supply's GND.
• Relay module logic side (coils/opto) runs on 5V from the SMPS; the switched (load) side runs on the separate 12V SMPS.
• Only the 4 heater/fan channels are wire-detailed here; the other 9 relay channels drive motors on their own 12/24V DC bus (not shown in detail).
• RELAY_ACTIVE_LOW = true in firmware: GPIO LOW energizes the relay coil, closing COM→NO.
